rows.result: Devastated — Ravaged by natural forces or razed by despoilers
Dying — Withered woodlands, blighted scrub, or sickly marshes
Sparse — Thin woodlands, bleak scrub, or stagnant marshes
Lush — Verdant woodlands, dense jungles, or thriving swamps
Primeval — Ancient jungles or impenetrable swamps
